title: Small fixes: plan floor 0.75, open the pane by agent focus, a lighter BORDER, the placeholder in dark orange, trust.rs's header
description: Settled while charting the map (harness-0sx, Notes: small fixes), in the /config prototype (harness-0sx.9, COLORS) and in the agent-CLI research (harness-0sx.13). Five small changes. (1) PLAN_FLOOR in src/orchestrator/judgment.rs goes from 0.8 to 0.75; FLOOR stays 0.7. (2) The Question option 'open the pane' (Screen::open_pane) runs herdr agent focus instead of herdr pane focus, which in herdr 0.9.1 only moves to a neighbour; check herdr agent focus --help for whether it takes the pane id or the agent name (agent_name(ticket, stage)). (3) BORDER in src/shell/logo.rs lifts to Rgb(84, 98, 124), the lighter divider grey the /config prototype settled on, so the Shell's boxes and dividers read. (4) The input line's placeholder draws in dark orange, Rgb(200, 110, 20), instead of BORDER; its text changes in Ticket 4. (5) src/orchestrator/trust.rs's header says a Codex pane at its trust screen reads idle: herdr's codex manifest now reads it as blocked; correct the header and any comment that repeats it.
acceptance_criteria: A plan Judgment of 0.76 approves and one of 0.74 asks (plan tests). Answering 'open the pane' runs herdr agent focus in the fake Tools' calls (shell tests). The BORDER and placeholder colors in a TestBackend render. cargo test and cargo clippy clean.
